_readme: Flight Control System (Experiment 5). Component catalog is shared with the platform — the assembled airframe sets the roll-axis inertia J that drives every closed loop. The four experiments are the four tabs: PID Tuning, Ziegler-Nichols, Sensor Fusion, Full System. localStorage stores PROGRESS ONLY; no values are read from or written to other experiments.

instructor.text: Welcome to the Flight Control System lab. A multirotor is open-loop unstable — the control loop is what makes stable flight. We build that loop across four tabs: PID Tuning, Ziegler-Nichols, Sensor Fusion, and the Full System.

First fix the airframe. In Input Parameters pick an Airframe — its take-off mass and arm length set the roll-axis inertia J = m L squared over two, shown live. Select the 5-inch airframe to reproduce the worked examples at J = 0.003.

Tab 1 · PID Tuning. Drag Kp, Ki and Kd, then Run to command an attitude step on the real one-over-J-s-squared plant. Raise Kp and watch overshoot climb past the 25% comfort limit while settling time stays fixed — that is set by Kd, not Kp. Turn on the disturbance torque to expose steady-state droop, then null it with Ki.

Tab 2 · Ziegler-Nichols. Raise the proportional sweep gain until the inner rate loop oscillates at constant amplitude — that latches the ultimate gain Ku and period Pu. Auto-tune reads the gains from the table; the classic tune is aggressive, so retune to Tyreus-Luyben. Then dial in real air resistance and wind and watch drag do the damping for free.

Tab 3 · Sensor Fusion. The gyro drifts, the accelerometer is noisy. The complementary filter blends them with one coefficient alpha. Sweep alpha and find the value that minimises the combined error — about 0.98 for the reference IMU. Set alpha to 1.0 and watch the ghost drone peel away as pure gyro integration drifts without bound.

Tab 4 · Full System. Now the controller acts on the estimate, not the truth. Fly every controller-by-estimator combination — nine flight-control systems — and read the live leaderboard. Every complementary-filter row scores in the high 90s; every gyro-only row collapses. The estimator choice dominates the controller choice.
Outstanding — the flight controller is tuned, the estimator chosen, and every tab verified. The Flight Controller Board and IMU are now unlocked in the Outputs panel.

reward.name: Flight Controller + IMU
reward.desc: Tuned PID gains, Ziegler-Nichols Ku/Pu, complementary-filter alpha and the chosen estimator — the stabilised flight-control configuration this experiment produces.
